configs.mechanism: price expansion continues after an executable entry (30-min plan section 7 S1 hypothesis)
resumption within an established trend offers sufficient net continuation
reversion toward value exceeds total execution costs in a quiet range
a measured reclaim supports a reversal toward the prior range
volume confirmation (vol_z>=1.0) filters false breaks and chasing
directional-fraction confirmation (10-bar buy_frac>=0.58, real-trade input) filters adverse drift during latency
regime filter (width<=120bps, >=2 touches) avoids trend-transition fades
cost cover (entry-to-mid>=26bps) avoids ranges narrower than round-trip costs
ablation: tests whether the pierce requirement costs genuine reversals
single-account bot under the same portfolio limits; must beat the strongest single family
